# Cowboy MCP

> Cowboy MCP is a WordPress plugin that turns any WordPress site into a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over Streamable HTTP, so AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can manage the site through a single authenticated endpoint.

Cowboy MCP exposes 121 tools (content CRUD plus WooCommerce, ACF, Elementor, Wordfence, and cache plugins), 17 read-only resources, 4 resource templates, and 8 workflow prompts. It is open source (GPL-2.0), fully self-contained (no Node.js, Composer, or build step), and distributed via GitHub Releases. The MCP endpoint is `/wp-json/cowboy-mcp/v1/endpoint` — JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP (MCP 2025-06-18). Authentication is a per-site bcrypt-hashed Bearer API key.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md): Overview, installation, agent setup, capabilities, security, and configuration
- [Connecting Claude Code](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md#claude-code): Exact `claude mcp add` command to connect Claude Code to WordPress
- [Connecting Codex](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md#codex): `~/.codex/config.toml` setup
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md#capabilities): Full list of tools, resources, and prompts
- [Security model](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md#security): Auth, rate limiting, safe mode, dry run, audit log, and power mode
- [FAQ](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/README.md#faq): Common questions about WordPress MCP servers
- [server.json](https://github.com/februality/cowboy-mcp/blob/main/server.json): Official MCP registry metadata
